lessons.claim: A discrete chain's λ_max is **the larger** of the bending and stretching blocks and not their sum. In a straight chain the stretching (x) and the bending (y) separate at linear order, so adding them in one matrix overestimates λ_max (in chain-bend, 0.0500 N/m instead of 0.0423 → dt 18% too small, purely a cost increase). The upper bound λ_max(A+B) ≤ λ_max(A)+λ_max(B) must not be used as it stands for dt.
